name: one-india-platform
description: Read approved retail sales, stock by category, target trends and category sell-through; optionally share confirmed unanswered questions.

interface.longDescription: Read your approved stores' sales, category stock, targets, footfall and category sell-through. Share a short unanswered question with the connector owner only after confirming the exact summary. Your own login, selected reports and store scope are required.
defaultPrompt: Check my 1 India AI access and show the reports and stores I can use.
Compare sales against targets and category sell-through for one approved store last week.
Show me a redacted summary of any unanswered report question and ask before saving it.
